scope: official EnsembleDesign development-panel actual-output generation; not dense budget AUC, time-matched, functional OOD, CodonFlow-RK main-model evidence or SOTA

execution.order: frozen record order; one official process per record
execution.stop_policy: official output has no terminal stop; append TAA only for disclosed shared-scorer evaluation
execution.official_efe_convention: LinearPartition/ViennaRNA ensemble free energy at 37 C with dangles=0

terminal_stop_policy: official output has no terminal stop; append TAA only for disclosed shared-scorer evaluation

cost.generation_wall_clock: one measured end-to-end official-process wall clock per record, including generation, internal LinearDesign initialization, LinearPartition scoring, startup and I/O
cost.shared_scorer_wall_clock: reported separately and never added to official generation time

recovery.scope: preserve the failed v1 attempt; recompute independent EFE with ViennaRNA fold-compound rescaling; reexecute only C41G7.2.1 and the six not-yet-run records in a new output root; combine 18 selected records without overwriting any v1 raw output
recovery.failure_root_cause: unscaled ViennaRNA pf() returned the failure sentinel 100000.0 for C41G7.2.1 run 1; MFE followed by fold_compound.exp_params_rescale(mfe) produced EFE within the frozen rounding tolerance in a diagnostic

stable_efe.method: RNA.fold_compound(sequence, md).mfe(), then fc.exp_params_rescale(mfe), then fc.pf()[1]
